hero.subheading: Blue Water's in-house customs team handles every declaration, document, and duty — so your cargo moves from Denmark to Norway without a single hold-up.
hero.stats_title: DK → NO Route at a Glance

process.heading: From Aarhus to Oslo in 5 Steps.
process.subtext: Our in-house customs team handles the entire clearance process — from export declaration in Denmark to final delivery in Norway.
process.step_1_body: We collect and verify all required shipping documents — commercial invoice, packing list, BoL, and certificates.
process.step_2_body: Our licensed declarants submit the export declaration through DTMS (Danish customs system) before departure.
process.step_3_body: Cargo moves under NCTS T1/T2 transit procedure — no physical border delays for bonded goods.
process.step_4_body: We submit the import declaration to Norwegian Customs (Tollvesenet) via TVINN before cargo arrives.
process.step_5_body: Once cleared, we confirm duty payment and coordinate final-mile delivery to your door.

documents.heading: Everything You Need. In One Place.
documents.subtext: All mandatory and optional documents for DK to NO shipments — templates, guides, and completed examples.
documents.doc_1_desc: Required for all shipments. Must include seller/buyer details, HS codes, declared value, and currency.
documents.doc_2_desc: Itemised list of cargo contents, quantities, weights, and dimensions per package.
documents.doc_3_desc: Sea BoL or CMR waybill confirming the contract of carriage and cargo receipt.
documents.doc_4_desc: Single Administrative Document — the core customs entry form submitted via DTMS or TVINN.
documents.doc_5_desc: EUR.1 movement certificate or origin declaration for preferential tariff treatment under EEA rules.
documents.doc_6_desc: Required for non-EEA goods moving in transit through EU/EEA territory under NCTS.

compliance.heading: Know the Rules. We Handle the Rest.
compliance.subtext: Norway is not an EU member but is part of the EEA. This means customs declarations are required for all goods — but preferential tariff rates apply for qualifying Danish exports.
compliance.item_1_body: Correct 8-digit HS code classification is critical for duty calculation and export statistics.
compliance.item_2_body: New Computerised Transit System — electronic transit declarations replace paper T-forms at all crossing points.
compliance.item_3_body: 25% Norwegian VAT applies to most imports. VOEC scheme applies for low-value B2C e-commerce shipments.
compliance.item_4_body: Danish goods qualifying under EEA rules of origin benefit from zero or reduced duty rates in Norway.
compliance.item_5_body: Blue Water holds Authorised Economic Operator certification — ensuring fast-track treatment at all checkpoints.
compliance.item_6_body: Chemical and regulated goods require additional compliance documentation before Norwegian customs clearance.

tracking.heading: Full Visibility. Zero Surprises.
